modules.comments:
This module defines a type of immutable byte strings, and associated
helper functions and type class instances. `String` conversions live in
`Data.ByteString.Encoding`, mutation in `Data.ByteString.ST`.

declarations.comments:
An immutable sequence of bytes.

`Eq` and `Ord` compare bytewise, ordering lexicographically. `show`
renders the bytes as lowercase hex, e.g. `ByteString "6869"`

modules.comments: Conversions between `String` and `ByteString` using different encodings

declarations.comments:
Encode a string to bytes under the given encoding, failing on unrepresentable
inputs. Use `fromStringLossy` for a lenient decoder that doesn't fail.
Per encoding, the input is rejected when:

- `UTF8`: it contains an unpaired surrogate
- `UTF16LE`: never fails
- `Latin1`: a UTF-16 code unit is above `0xFF`
- `Hex`: the length is odd, or a character is not a hex digit
- `Base64`: anything but a canonically padded RFC 4648 encoding, e.g. a length
  not a multiple of four, a character outside the standard and URL-safe
  alphabets, `=` other than as final padding (at most two), or nonzero
  unused bits in the final data character.
declarations.title: fromString

declarations.comments:
Encode a string to bytes under the given encoding, lossily.
Substitutions per encoding:
- `UTF8`: substitutes U+FFFD for an unpaired surrogate
- `UTF16LE`: exact
- `Latin1`: masks each code unit to its low byte
- `Hex`: stops at the first non-hex character or a trailing lone digit
- `Base64`: skips any character outside the alphabet (whitespace, `=`,
  anything else)
declarations.title: fromStringLossy

declarations.comments:
Decode bytes to a string under the given encoding, returning `Nothing`
when a strict UTF decoder rejects the input (invalid UTF-8, or an
odd-length UTF-16 buffer)
declarations.title: toString

declarations.comments:
Decode bytes to a string under the given encoding, total in every case.
Per encoding:

- `UTF8`: substitutes U+FFFD for invalid bytes
- `UTF16LE`: drops a trailing odd byte and decodes the even prefix
- `Latin1`, `Hex`, `Base64`: never fail
declarations.title: toStringLossy

modules.comments:
This module defines a type of mutable byte strings in the `ST` monad,
and associated helper functions. For a long-lived buffer in `Effect`,
use the `Global` region with `Control.Monad.ST.Global.toEffect`.

declarations.comments:
A reference to a mutable byte string.

The type parameter represents the memory region which the byte string
belongs to. The runtime representation of an `STByteString h` is the same
as that of a `ByteString`, except that mutation is allowed.
declarations.title: STByteString

declarations.comments: Create a mutable byte string of the given length, filled with zeros.
declarations.title: create

declarations.comments:
Create a mutable byte string of the given length, filled with the given
byte value.
declarations.title: createWith

declarations.comments:
Get the length of a mutable byte string in bytes; pure, as a buffer cannot
be resized after allocation.
declarations.title: length

declarations.comments:
Read the byte at the given index, returning `Nothing` if the index is out
of range.
declarations.title: index

declarations.comments:
Read the byte at the given index, throwing an exception if the index is
out of range. Use `index` for safe access.
declarations.title: unsafeIndex

declarations.comments:
Set the byte at the given index, throwing an exception if the index is

declarations.comments:
Copy `count` bytes from `src` (at `srcOffset`) into `dest` (at
`destOffset`), throwing an exception if either range is out of bounds.
`dest` and `src` may be the same buffer and the ranges may overlap: the
destination always receives the bytes the source range held before the
copy began.
declarations.title: copyInto

declarations.comments:

afterwards does not affect the result.
declarations.title: freeze

declarations.comments:
Create a mutable copy of an immutable byte string; mutating the result
does not affect the source.
declarations.title: thaw
